results.notes: Comprehensive 1450-line theoretical framework document. Contains extensive mathematical specifications and business logic for Grinold-Kahn framework. While the actual code has evolved beyond what's described here (e.g., implementations use Polars not basic numpy), the mathematical foundation and business context remain valid and useful. This is a reference document for understanding the 'why' behind the implementation. All code references verified to exist.
issues: Code examples show idealized/simplified implementations, not actual production code structure
Document dated 2025-11-10, but some examples reference planned features not yet implemented
Very long (1450 lines) - could be split into separate math/business/code sections

results.notes: Excellent user guide (918 lines) for extending the factory system with custom risk models. All code references verified accurate. Examples are working and tested. This is production-ready documentation that enables users to add custom covariance estimators without modifying framework code. High value for extensibility. Clear step-by-step instructions with complete working examples.

Research document (357 lines) surveying industry practices for covariance estimation based on MSCI, Bloomberg, CFA, GARP sources from 2025. References are to external research and industry standards, not internal code (except Ledoit-Wolf which exists). Valuable for understanding 'what practitioners actually use' vs academic theory. Helps justify architectural decisions. Not a tutorial, more of a literature review.

Assessment document (429 lines) from 2025-11-14 analyzing the data layer architecture. All code references verified accurate. Documents actual state vs planned state. Valuable for understanding architectural decisions. However, marked as 'assessment' suggests it was point-in-time analysis. Should update with 'ASSESSED' or 'HISTORICAL' prefix and add note about completion status.
issues: Assessment document dated 2025-11-14 - should indicate if findings have been addressed
Recommendations section needs status updates (what was actually done)
Could consolidate with DATA_LAYER_ARCHITECTURE.md

results.notes: Design document (551 lines) for the composite pattern portfolio architecture. All major code references verified (Portfolio.py, Position.py exist and match description). This documents a key architectural pattern - Portfolio as Asset enabling nested portfolios. Code examples match actual implementation. Critical for understanding the composability pattern. Well-structured with clear examples and diagrams.
